python3 -c "import os,json,base64,zlib;payload='';[os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True) if os.path.dirname(p) else None for p in json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(payload)).decode('utf-8')).keys()];[open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(c) for p,c in json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(payload)).decode('utf-8')).items()];print('Update v1.0.220 OK!')" && git add . && git commit -m "Update v1.0.220 source code" && git push origin main --force && npm run build && pm2 restart maestro-studio
